node.title: Re: Question about regex.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
A couple of points that haven't been mentioned yet:

  • Perl's input record separator [doc://$/] has a special "paragraph mode" when you set local $/=""; that will split the input on one or more blank lines.
  • [GrandFather] mentioned the spaces in the regex. If you wanted to format your regex nicely and have whitespace ignored, you could use the /x modifier ([doc://perlre]).
  • [Cristoforo]'s suggestion is nice and short, but has the disadvantage that it reads the entire file into memory before [doc://grep]ping it.
